title: Crosslist Free Trial: Is There One? (And Best Alternatives)
summary: Looking for a reselling tool with a free trial? Let's look at Crosslist's actual trial policy, the fine print, and what to know before you sign up.
body_markdown:
As of 2026, there is no true Crosslist free trial


. Instead, the platform requires sellers to pay upfront for a subscription and offers a 3-day money-back guarantee as long as your account has created less than 20 listings. This "pay-to-test" model makes it challenging to fully evaluate a tool's workflow without putting in their credit card details.


Because of this barrier to entry, many resellers are pivoting to platforms like Vendoo


, which offer a completely free 14-day trial with zero upfront payment required.


## Main Takeaways


- Crosslist requires full payment upfront, ranging from $29.99 to $44.99/mo, before a seller can access any features.


- The 3-day money-back guarantee window starts the moment of purchase, not when a seller actually gets around to testing the tool.


- Creating more than 20 listings, whether manual or imported, instantly voids Crosslist's refund eligibility.


- Auto-delisting, the most critical feature for avoiding double-selling, only starts at Crosslist's $39.99 Gold tier.


- Vendoo offers a genuine 14-day free trial with full feature access and no upfront payment required.


- A true free trial gives sellers enough time to connect marketplaces, test bulk actions, and confirm auto-delisting works on a real sale.


## How Crosslist's "Risk-Free" Guarantee Actually Works


Source: Crosslist


### **The Upfront Payment**


To even see the inside of the Crosslist dashboard, a seller has to select a pricing tier and pay for their first month before getting access. There's no way to browse the actual tool without committing to a charge first. If you're wondering[how much is Crosslist](https://blog.vendoo.co/how-much-is-crosslist) , the four monthly tiers break down like this:


- Bronze ($29.99/mo): 200 new listings/mo


- Silver ($34.99/mo): 500 new listings/mo


- Gold ($39.99/mo): 1,000 new listings/mo


- Diamond ($44.99/mo): unlimited new listings/mo


Sellers can also choose quarterly billing (10% off) or yearly billing (2 months free), though committing to a longer plan means tying up even more money before knowing if the tool fits their workflow. Each tier also offers an optional AI add-on for an extra $4.99/mo


, which unlocks AI-generated listings and AI photo editing.


### **The 72-Hour Window**


The refund countdown starts the minute the subscription is purchased


, not when a seller actually gets around to testing it. Here's what that actually means:


- The window "starts at the moment of Purchase and ends exactly 72 hours later" as stated in Crosslist's own terms


- Refund requests go through chat support, so you rely on being able to access someone via chat within 72 hours to get your refund


- The guarantee only applies to a seller's first purchase (return customers aren't eligible at all)


- Annual plans get hit with a $9.99 processing fee if refunded (monthly and quarterly plans don't)


If a seller doesn't contact support within that window, they waive their right to a refund entirely, no exceptions.


### **The 20-Listing Limit Trap**


This is the biggest restriction. Per Crosslist's own terms, the money-back guarantee only applies if a seller has "not created more than 20 listings within the application, whether through manual creation or any form of import." Here's what that means:


- Sellers can create up to 20 listings and stay eligible for a refund


- The 21st import or manually created listing voids the guarantee instantly


- This cap applies whether the listings came from manual entry or bulk import, like connecting a Poshmark closet
